leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a basic in-memory cache object to store API responses
Implement a function that checks for cached data and returns it if available
Construct a stale-while-revalidate mechanism that serves stale data while fetching fresh data in the background
Configure cache expiration logic to determine when data becomes stale
Integrate the cache system with a mock API fetch function to demonstrate the pattern
Manipulate cache state to update it with fresh data after background revalidation
Apply error handling to ensure the system gracefully falls back when revalidation fails
lessonTitle: Build stale while revalidate API cache
